question_text: A 30-year-old woman came to her OBGYN for an infertility consultation. The patient reports having intercourse with her husband at least 3 times per week with increasing frequency during the periods. The lab reports of her husband revealed an adequate sperm count. After the work-ups was complete, her OBGYN prescribed a medication similar to GnRH to be administered in a pulsatile manner. Which drug is prescribed to the patient?
